SELECT c.ALARM_GRP_NO, c.ALARM_GRP_NAME, IFNULL(b.RTU_TYPE, '-') AS RTU_TYPE, a.ORIGIN_RTU_ID, IFNULL(b.RTU_NAME, '-') AS RTU_NAME, d.EVENT_SEQ, e.EVENT_BRANCH, e.EVENT_COMMENT, d.EVENT_DATE, d.BATTERY_VOLT, d.EVENT_CODE, d.EVENT_VALUE FROM ALARM_GROUP_MEMBER AS a LEFT JOIN RTU_INFO AS b ON a.ORIGIN_RTU_ID = b.RTU_ID LEFT JOIN ALARM_GROUP_INFO AS c ON a.ALARM_GRP_NO = c.ALARM_GRP_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT * FROM EVENT_HIST
WHERE EVENT_CODE IN (19, 20, 23, 25)
WHERE EVENT_CODE IN (19, 20, 21, 23, 25, 27)
WHERE EVENT_CODE IN (19, 20, 21, 23, 25, 27, 33, 37, 101, 102, 103, 104)
WHERE EVENT_CODE IN (19, 20, 21, 23, 25, 27, 33, 34, 37, 38, 101, 102, 103, 104)
ORDER BY EVENT_DATE DESC) AS F GROUP BY F.RTU_ID ) AS d ON b.RTU_ID = d.RTU_ID LEFT JOIN event_info AS e ON d.EVENT_CODE = e.EVENT_CODE WHERE c.ORGAN_ID = #{organ_id} ORDER BY ALARM_GRP_NO, binary(RTU_NAME)

SELECT a.GROUP_ID, COUNT(b.RTU_ID) RTU_CNT, a.GROUP_NAME, a.ORGAN_ID FROM group_info AS a LEFT JOIN rtu_group AS b ON a.GROUP_ID = b.GROUP_ID LEFT JOIN rtu_info AS c ON b.RTU_ID = c.RTU_ID WHERE c.RTU_TYPE IN ('B00', 'BD0','BR0','BF0','BA0') AND c.RTU_ID IS NOT NULL
AND c.ORGAN_ID = #{organ_id}
AND c.RTU_ID IN (#{isRtuId})
GROUP BY a.GROUP_ID ORDER BY a.GROUP_ID

SELECT a.GROUP_ID, c.RTU_ID, c.RTU_NAME, c.SORT_FLAG, c.MODEL_NO FROM group_info AS a LEFT JOIN rtu_group AS b ON a.GROUP_ID = b.GROUP_ID LEFT JOIN rtu_info AS c ON b.RTU_ID = c.RTU_ID WHERE c.RTU_TYPE IN ('B00', 'BD0','BR0','BF0','BA0') AND c.RTU_ID IS NOT NULL
AND c.ORGAN_ID = #{organ_id}
AND c.RTU_ID IN (#{is_rtu_id})
ORDER BY a.GROUP_ID, c.SORT_FLAG

SELECT c.AREA_CODE, a.EVENT_SEQ, c.RTU_NAME, b.EVENT_BRANCH, b.EVENT_COMMENT, a.EVENT_DATE, a.BATTERY_VOLT, a.EVENT_CODE, a.EVENT_VALUE FROM event_hist AS a LEFT JOIN event_info AS b ON a.EVENT_CODE = b.EVENT_CODE LEFT JOIN rtu_info AS c ON a.RTU_ID = c.RTU_ID WHERE c.RTU_ID IS NOT NULL
AND a.EVENT_CODE IN (19, 20, 23, 25)
AND a.EVENT_CODE IN (19, 20, 21, 23, 25, 27)
AND a.EVENT_CODE IN (19, 20, 21, 23, 25, 27, 33, 37, 101, 102, 103, 104)
AND a.EVENT_CODE IN (19, 20, 21, 23, 25, 27, 33, 34, 37, 38, 101, 102, 103, 104)
AND a.EVENT_DATE BETWEEN #{sdate} AND #{edate}
ORDER BY a.EVENT_SEQ DESC
LIMIT 0, #{alert_cnt}
